name: calls_update
description: Updates information about a Call. (POST /calls.update). The id argument is the exact opaque primary key, not a human name, title, external code, or numeric code suffix.

id.description: `id` returned by the [`calls.add`](/methods/calls.add) method. The id argument is the exact opaque primary key, not a human name, title, external code, or numeric code suffix.

join_url.description: The URL required for a client to join the Call.

desktop_app_join_url.description: When supplied, available Slack clients will attempt to directly launch the 3rd-party Call with this URL.
